text: Thanks for the replies, we ended up travelling to the Tel Aviv office to try for an intervisa but were told only Eilat can issue after the initial meeting, so very frustrating! I’m struggling to see the logic in it as I am currently on a visitor visa. If I leave and come back, I am also on a visitor visa. My invitation from the Israeli consulate in London and my intention to settle will be in the system as ‘waiting for initial interview’ surely?
